physicalFindings.finding: All six selected atlases show compact adult figures in plain green clothing with dark outlines and ochre hands/face/boots. A_LEFT_02 restores full sleeves. Its brighter green/shading differs slightly from RIGHT but stays within the unresolved tiny-source reconstruction range. No red uniform or Running Man grey chest patch.
No modern gun, visibly defined grenade launcher, flamethrower, C4 vest, Fatman roller/bomber equipment or source HUD pistol/ration copied as enemy gear was observed. No new gear model is certified.
Both facings show12complete poses: idle2/walk4/guard2/crouch2/jump2; last two are whole-body rising/tucked jumps, not missing feet or substituted crouches. Hands/boots remain visible.

Both facings show punch3/heavy3/low3/hit1/ko2. Index9 reads backward recoil, index10 kneeling collapse, index11 complete prone/side-turned lying body. These are authored Versus normals/reactions, not certified original martial arts or supine choreography.

Preparation and arm-extension poses show a tiny green/dark hand-connected object; reset is empty-handed. This supports only a restrained authored hand-grenade/release interpretation. Exact grenade shape, fuze, grip, launcher model and original firing animation remain unresolved; a distinct released projectile is not visibly certified.

Both first-active low-hand poses contain a short white segment near floor with a bent/stepped connection near the hand. RIGHT has an especially straight horizontal end; LEFT can read as a thin blade-like stroke. No definite knife guard/handle/model is resolved. Accept only as a stylized white-wire placement segment with explicit wire/lame ambiguity; do not name or certify a knife/device. No mandatory regeneration recommended for this bounded qualification.

Both index7figures read primarily as an extended arm/closed-hand follow-through, not a visible victim throw. Accept as authored unarmed arm-extension/contact follow-through; never call it a demonstrated canonical CQC throw or certify target-body mechanics.
Both triplets show planted/resting poses, breathing/reset-to-ready progression. No travel-running sequence or carried prop is needed to explain them.

Left and right are visibly separately authored poses with different limb/shading placement, not presented as exact anatomical source asymmetry. A_LEFT_02 is a new imagegen edit of the independently generated left attempt, using RIGHT only as a sleeve reference.

The independent threshold measurements found exactly12major connected bodies per sheet at alpha>80 and alpha>=8, with explicit4-neighbor and8-neighbor sensitivity checks; no thresholded native body touches an atlas edge. Small disconnected low-alpha pixels remain native and are not asserted to be anatomy.
